# Cardano, sponsor map (fixture)

The sponsor runs a track on agentic commerce. Its customers are lending pools and their lenders.

Use case: Example Lender holds a withdrawal queue that its lenders cannot see.

## Customers

| Name | Segment | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Example Lender | lending | runs a pool with a withdrawal queue |
| Example Desk | institutional | settles redemptions |
